items.title: Kent Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: Say for instance Detroit, where people like Joe Henderson, the Joneses — Elvin Jones, Hank Jones and Thad Jones — Kenny Garrett, Ron Carter, James Carter, Regina Carter —

ctx.x: You know when you see promo written about people, if you’re from New York or you’re from New Orleans, most likely the promoter or the people who write that copy are going to mention that, especially if you’re playing out of town. Does it mean something to you? Do you think it’s important that you’re from New Orleans as far as the way you play?

I think that’s a really tough and interesting question. Because what happens is that sometimes you forget about other cities. Say for instance Detroit, where people like Joe Henderson, the Joneses — Elvin Jones, Hank Jones and Thad Jones — Kenny Garrett, Ron Carter, James Carter, Regina Carter —
